ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) base with localized high-intensity (white) clusters at distal tips and along linear markings, estimated at 85:15 dark-to-light ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous regions located at distal left and distal right tips. Central and medial fluke regions composed of uniform low-intensity pixels interspersed with high-intensity linear vectors and circular clusters on the superior margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch at the central axis, approximately 90 degrees, with depth penetrating roughly 15% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge with frequent low-amplitude (2-5 pixel) serrations and multiple larger concave indentations (5-15 pixels) across the continuous boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the superior margins, curving sharply downward to acute points at the lateral terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular high-intensity pixel clusters (5-15px diameter) concentrated primarily along the superior trailing edge and central-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous high-contrast linear pixel disruptions. Left lobe contains three primary diagonal parallel streaks; right lobe features a dense array of four to five parallel horizontal/curvilinear lines in the lower quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake-mark scarring across both lobes; a small, localized reddish-pigmented lesion visible on the right inner lobe surface near the central notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density cluster of nearly horizontal, parallel white lines on the lower right margin, exhibiting higher regularity than the scarring on the left lobe.
